author: Widogeist
body: It's never too late. There are tons of beginner kingdoms out there, and the game is always adding new content (for all levels). Endgame is in a stalemate right now, so there's no rush to power through.

author: TU4AR
body:
I just started last month so I was there with you.

In my area there is a lot of dead players, so you can take over their area once you hit near their level.

But other than that there is a large active community.

MOST of the time , they aren't helpful and will tell you to read the wiki. It's kinda of in crowd in the game general chat depending on your region. 

The discord and subreddit are a lot better for help and general information.

author: msg45f
body:
No, I don't really think the game plays like other major mobile games where people progress pretty linearly with time due to major time gating of almost everything. And unless you just really want to focus solely on PVP, most of the content is not really directly pitting you against other players in a way that I would consider you advantaged/disadvantaged based on start time.

Perfectly fine to start fresh now. I think the game is pretty accepting of playing at whatever pace you want - if that means pushing hard to be competitive with endgame content then the game fully empowers you to do that if you want to dedicate the effort.

author: Pyremoo
body:
Nope - now's a great time to start.  
There's plenty of info on Orna.Guide to help you get started + here on the subbreddit.  
PvP is a very minor part of the game, mostly opt-in, and the rewards are never 'mandatory'. As an example: holding a specific area can get you say, 8 orns a **week**. Killing one low level mob (say ~level 40) will get you like twice that right **now**.

author: Palocos
body:
Nope. There have been a lot of quality of life and farming xp/currency improvements that make the game much better right now. The majority of the game is pve so don't worry about starting right now.

It's still grindy as f*ck though, so it takes a very long time to reach endgame content (more than any other game I've played). Unless you're into serious co-op play with strangers through discord in order to reach the endgame fast.

author: m_ik_e
body:
I started a couple of months ago myself, playing ab 1hr per day and just got to T7. The game might be overwhelming in the beginning but one can get the hang of it quite fast. I can honestly say that this game got me walking more than I'd expect.

Good luck with your adventure!

Edit: Community is awesome, there is no Pay2Win, and there is a catalog for everything in game. 

Edit2: Every week I personally buy some shop items or a coffee for the developer in order to help maintain the game alive and kicking.

author: failingstars
body: I started a few weeks ago and I'm having fun. It's more of a solo game imo, and the community has been great so far. I would suggest joining the Discord because it's the best source of help imo. It's also way more active than the regional chat.
